passage.description: for change: the exact current passage being replaced, copied from the article; may extend to adjacent sentences within the same paragraph, cell, caption, or footnote when the same fact anchors them

replacement_passage.description: for change: the full replacement passage, changing only what the evidence requires

comment.description: for editorial_escalation: the anchored comment, including your best attempted draft marked as such and the evidence

problem.description: what the article's value was anchored to and any text beyond the passage now dated with it; empty for no_change

reason.description: 2-4 sentences; for no_change say what you checked, for unverifiable what you searched for

quote.description: verbatim words from the source that settle the point

date.description: publication or access date, YYYY-MM-DD when known
